column3: Close to the Hebrew; “like does” is rendered “like hinds' feet.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Your humility” is rendered “Your gentleness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my ankles” is rendered “my feet.”
Close to the Hebrew; “You made bow down” is rendered “You have subdued.”
“You gave me the neck of my enemies” is rendered “You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “on the face of the wind” is rendered “before the wind.”
Close to the Hebrew; “sons of foreignness” is rendered “Foreigners,” and “cringe” as “submit.”
Close to the Hebrew; “also” is rendered “Surely.”
Close to the Hebrew; “making great the victories” is rendered “He gives great deliverance.”
